title: Adaptive Mass-Segmented KV Compression for Long-Context Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.23200v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache is a critical bottleneck in long-form LLM inference. Existing KV compression methods mitigate this by evicting tokens based on importance scores. However, we show that their reliance on global Top-k selection triggers Region Wipe-out: the severe eviction of contiguous reasoning blocks that derails logical coherence. To address this, we propose Adaptive Mass-Segmented (AMS) KV Compression, a framework that shifts the paradigm from token-level competition to region-aware quota allocation. AMS adaptively partitions the KV cache based on the spatial distribution of attention mass, ensuring structurally vital reasoning segments receive guaranteed memory quotas. To ensure stability during iterative decoding, an EMA-based smoothing mechanism is incorporated to prevent jitter in segment boundaries. Crucially, AMS is a universal plug-and-play layer that is orthogonal to existing scorers. It

translated_title: 面向长上下文推理的自适应质量分段KV压缩
translated_abstract: 键值缓存的线性增长是长文本LLM推理中的关键瓶颈。现有的KV压缩方法通过基于重要性分数驱逐令牌来缓解这一问题。然而，我们证明它们对全局Top-k选择的依赖会触发“区域抹除”现象：即连续的推理块被严重驱逐，从而破坏逻辑连贯性。为解决这一问题，我们提出自适应质量分段KV压缩，该框架将范式从令牌级竞争转变为区域感知的配额分配。AMS根据注意力质量的空间分布自适应地划分KV缓存，确保结构上至关重要的推理片段获得有保障的内存配额。为保证迭代解码过程中的稳定性，该方法引入了基于EMA（指数移动平均）的平滑机制，以防止分段边界出现抖动。至关重要的是，AMS是一个通用的即插即用层，与现有的评分器相互正交。
tldr: 论文提出自适应质量分段（AMS）KV压缩框架，将KV缓存压缩从令牌级的全局Top-k竞争范式转变为基于注意力质量空间分布的区域感知配额分配，有效避免了“区域抹除”导致的推理逻辑断裂，且可作为与现有评分器正交的即插即用层。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Adaptive Mass-Segmented (AMS) KV Compression, which shifts the paradigm from global Top-k token-level competition to region-aware quota allocation based on the spatial distribution of attention mass, preventing "Region Wipe-out" of contiguous reasoning blocks while serving as a universal plug-and-play layer orthogonal to existing scorers.
